mapper.select: select BO.BID_ID bidId, ee.finprod_id finprodId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, ee.Entrust_Date biddate, fp.trade_market tradeMarket, ee.counter_id counterId, bo.remark remark from ETR_ENTRUST ee INNER JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE edb on ee.entrust_id = edb.entrust_id left join BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on ee.entrust_id = bobp.entrust_id left join BID_ORDER BO ON bobp.bid_id = BO.BID_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE eebp on ee.entrust_id = eebp.entrust_id left join FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = ee.FINPROD_ID where edb.rec_status in (#{entruststatusyjs},'04') and ee.finprod_type2 = #{pinanassettypeyj} and ee.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ( ee.counter_id =#{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or ee.counter_id is null) AND instr(','||#{entrustId}||',', ','||ee.ENTRUST_ID||',') > 0 and rownum = 1

select ee.entrust_id entrustId, pp.portfolio_id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, eebp.bid_prin_amt bidPrinAmt, eebp.bid_price * 100 bidPrice from ETR_ENTRUST ee INNER JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE edb on ee.entrust_id = edb.entrust_id left join ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE eebp on ee.entrust_id = eebp.entrust_id left join ptl_portfolio pp ON pp.portfolio_id = eebp.PORTFOLIO_ID where edb.rec_status in (#{entruststatusyjs},'04') and ee.finprod_type2 = #{pinanassettypeyj} and ee.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ( ee.counter_id =#{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or ee.counter_id is null) AND instr(','||#{entrustId}||',', ','||ee.ENTRUST_ID||',') > 0
and ee.entrust_id not in (select BOBP.ENTRUST_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE BOBP )
and ee.entrust_id in (select BOBP.ENTRUST_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE BOBP where BOBP.Bid_Id = #{bidId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select sum(eebp.bid_prin_amt) hzallBidPrinAmt, eebp.bid_price * 100 bidPrice from ETR_ENTRUST ee INNER JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE edb on ee.entrust_id = edb.entrust_id left join ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE eebp on ee.entrust_id = eebp.entrust_id where edb.rec_status in (#{entruststatusyjs},'04') and ee.finprod_type2 = #{pinanassettypeyj} and ee.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ( ee.counter_id =#{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or ee.counter_id is null) AND instr(','||#{entrustId}||',', ','||ee.ENTRUST_ID||',') > 0
and ee.entrust_id not in (select BOBP.ENTRUST_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE BOBP )
and ee.entrust_id in (select BOBP.ENTRUST_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE BOBP where BOBP.Bid_Id = #{bidId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
group by eebp.bid_price

select decode(BO.IS_WIN,'','${TENDERCONFIRMSTATUS02}',decode(BO.IS_WIN,'${bidstatusyzb}','${TENDERCONFIRMSTATUS04}','${TENDERCONFIRMSTATUS03}')) tenderconfirmstatus from BID_ORDER bo where bo.bid_id = #{bidId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
